location: Mostly in the Chania regional unit (Crete); also in Epirus and the Dodecanese according to To Vima, or in Ioannina and the Cyclades according to LiFO
transaction_type: mostly donation or purchase, some inheritance
detail: To Vima reports 26 properties, most of them in Chania, acquired mainly by donation or purchase and some by inheritance; Fortune Greece and SKAI report no change from the previous declaration. The declared income from property was 10,700 EUR for fiscal year 2024. The two outlets differ on which island group is concerned (Dodecanese or Cyclades); no addresses are given here. Declaration for 2025 covering fiscal year 2024, published on 11 May 2026. Greek MPs file an annual asset declaration (δήλωση περιουσιακής κατάστασης, 'pothen esches') that the Hellenic Parliament's audit committee publishes on hellenicparliament.gr; that site was not readable for this research (access denied to the harvest), so the figures are taken from press reports that cite the declaration. The separate declaration of his spouse is not reproduced.
